upstream.uses: CapScan run on 347 acquisitions / 15 participants (Slurm 6064031_3): complete_statistical_families.tsv (panels a-f display cells and q values, via source_data/Fig6) and participant_motif_differences.tsv.gz (recomputation of the 32,400-test motif family). PREDICT run on 306 acquisitions / 93 patients (Slurm 5937597): acquisition_enrichment.tsv.gz (panels g,h patient means; recomputation of the 1,560-test source family) and complete_statistical_families.tsv (plotted means and 95% intervals). The sign-flip, bootstrap and BH functions and the motif and source-enrichment loops are moved into figures/SFig13/panels.py.
